title: Experts disagree on tsup.config.ts
context:
Chief architect: These two are complementary, not opposed. Correctness wins the ordering: a hook that cannot load its compiled half is a total outage, while the package-size concern is bounded because the parity rule only admits modules a hook actually imports. Adopting the first claim already satisfies the second.

Target: tsup.config.ts
- devops-engineer: Every module a runtime hook lazy-imports from dist must be a declared bundler entry, so the shipped package can satisfy the import.
- devops-engineer: Adding bundler entries grows the published package; the added surface should stay limited to modules a hook actually imports.
